lines.say: less knee osteoarthritis pain, like NSAIDs (small trials, early evidence)
less soreness and lower muscle-damage markers after exercise (limited evidence)
some benefit in early fatty liver studies; unclear which measures improve
liver tests if tiredness, dark urine, or yellow skin or eyes appear
rare liver injury 1 to 4 months in; 1 of 10 US cases died (case series)
may add to bleeding with blood thinners and NSAIDs; INR rose on warfarin (case report)
may be unsafe in pregnancy; a monograph advises avoiding it while pregnant or nursing
